status.purpose: Whose-turn or result line, with a small drawn mark.

shadows.name: sheet-frame
shadows.purpose: 1px hairline that closes the outer edge of the ruled grid. Not elevation.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single easing for every transition and draw-on.

motion.name: hash-draw
motion.purpose: Board dividers drawing on at load.

motion.purpose: Hover, press, win dimming (0.4 losers, 0.6 draw).

components.name: New Game Button
components.description: Full-width ink bar; flips to orange on hover and press.
components.css: .ds-new-game { width: 100%; padding: 0.95rem 1rem; background: var(--ink, #121212); color: var(--paper, #fafaf6); font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 90ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-new-game:hover { background: var(--accent, #ff4a1c); color: var(--on-accent, #121212); } .ds-new-game:active { background: var(--accent, #ff4a1c); color: var(--on-accent, #121212); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-new-game:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #121212); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Board Square
components.description: Transparent cell button; tints on hover, shows a ghost X on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-square" aria-label="Square 1,1, empty"><svg class="ds-ghost" viewBox="0 0 100 100" width="78" height="78" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M20 18L82 84M80 20L22 82" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-square { width: 120px; aspect-ratio: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #121212); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-ghost { opacity: 0; transition: opacity 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-square:hover { background: var(--tint, rgba(47,75,255,0.09)); } .ds-square:hover .ds-ghost { opacity: 0.16; } .ds-square:active { background: var(--press, rgba(47,75,255,0.18)); } .ds-square:active .ds-ghost { opacity: 0.3; } .ds-square:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--ink, #121212); outline-offset: -8px; } .ds-square:focus-visible .ds-ghost { opacity: 0.16; }

components.name: Score Row
components.description: Three equal cells divided by ink hairlines, aligned to board columns.
components.css: .ds-score { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border-block: 1px solid var(--ink, #121212); margin: 0; } .ds-score div { padding: 0.6rem 0.75rem 0.5rem; overflow: hidden; } .ds-score div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-score dt { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-score dd { margin: 0; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Status Line
components.description: Whose-turn text led by a small drawn mark.
components.html: X's turn
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; margin: 0; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(1.6rem, 8cqw, 2.4rem); letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.1; color: var(--ink, #121212); }

narrative.overview:
An exact grid with a wild hand on it. The sheet is ruled in faint blue construction hairlines that divide the space into square cells; everything else (board, score row, bar) hangs off those cell edges. The marks are the only unruly thing: seeded black-marker X and O scribbles made of several overlapping strokes, drawn on at the moment of play. One signal orange appears when something is decided: the winning strike, and the press of New Game.

The register is a Crouwel-style gridded specimen: neo-grotesque type, tabular numerals, sharp corners, ink on paper. Dark mode keeps the same plan on a blue-black ground. The board is the hero; chrome stays quiet, flat, and hairline-thin.
keyCharacteristics: Visible cell grid; board edges land on construction lines (half-cell sheet margin).
Sharp corners everywhere, no radius anywhere.
Marker-scribble marks, deterministic per seed, drawn on stroke by stroke.
Orange is rare and means "decided" or "act".
Flat: depth comes from hairlines and tint, never shadow.
Light and dark follow the system.

rules.name: The One Strike Rule
rules.body: Orange marks a decision or an action, and nothing else. If a screen shows more than one orange element at rest, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Blue Is Only Air Rule
rules.body: Construction blue exists only as a low-alpha tint of the grid and cell states. It is never text, a border at full strength, or a button.

rules.name: The Mark Reads Without Color Rule
rules.body: X and O are distinguished by shape (diagonals versus loops), never by hue; orange is reserved for the strike.

rules.name: The Weight Does The Work Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size in one family; do not introduce a second typeface.

rules.name: The Cell Alignment Rule
rules.body: Anything that sits under or beside the board is measured in the board's cell units (cqw), not in rem or percentages of the viewport.

rules.name: The Flat Sheet Rule
rules.body: Surfaces never lift; feedback is a tint change or a stroke, not a shadow.

dos: Do align every new element to cell edges (25cqw cell, 12.5cqw half-cell inset).
Do keep corners square and structure flat; use 1px hairlines for division.
Do build new marks, strikes, or illustrations from the scribble generator so they stay deterministic and share the marker hand.
Do keep hover, focus, and press states distinct (tint, outline, deeper tint) and make hover conditional on `(hover: hover)`.
Do gate any new animation behind `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
Do define colors as custom properties on `:root` with a dark override.
donts: Don't use orange for anything that is not a decision or an action.
Don't use emoji, stock icons, or rounded pastel card styling.
Don't use full-strength blue; it is only a transparent tint.
Don't introduce a second typeface or color-coded X and O.
Don't use `disabled` on squares; keep `aria-disabled` so focus survives.
